com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.domain - package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.domain
Domain model and ports of the service client.
com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.domain.documents - package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.domain.documents
Documents the service client reads on the resource server: the Document model, the two ports (DocumentGateway with the client's own token and OnBehalfOfDocumentGateway on behalf of a user) and the failure they report.
